remarks: Are you looking for an affordable, cash-flowing property in the Historic City of Niagara Falls with an attractive cap rate? This renovated 6-unit building is offering over 8,000 sq ft under one newer roof that provides the scale investors seek in a market known for strong rental demand. Fully occupied currently generating over $67,000 per year in rents. The property features low-maintenance vinyl siding, newer windows, and updated electric service, helping reduce future capital expenses. A full basement and attic offer additional storage or potential for work space, adding further functionality to the investment. Located in one of Western New York’s most historic and recognized cities that is close to the Canadian border. This Niagara Falls property presents a compelling opportunity for investors looking to add size, stability, and value to their portfolio at an affordable price. Seller will provide an income & expense report with proof of funds.
